claim: *Modeling and enforcement are separate decisions.* The measurement model defines the quantity and reference bound; Alignment determines whether the result is observed, used to adapt behavior, used to trigger graceful degradation, or enforced by a gate.

topology.description: Separate measurement modeling and enforcement decisions over one shared model; four equal choices.

required_terms: Model: what quantity and bound matter? Alignment: what enforcement is justified?
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Model gray repeated across the handoff. Degrade/gate use stronger gray than observe/adapt to retain consequential-action distinction.
redesign: Model gray repeated across the handoff. Degrade/gate use stronger gray than observe/adapt to retain consequential-action distinction.
alt: A quantity and reference bound are compared in the modeling stage. The enforcement stage uses that same model and branches to four peer choices: observe, adapt, degrade or gate. Modeling names what matters; enforcement chooses its force. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
